headline: Decade-old RAM is making a comeback
summary: RAM price hikes are pushing CPU makers to support older tech. Intel and AMD are developing new CPUs compatible with DDR4 RAM. This move aims to make PC upgrades more affordable.

headline: Anthropic’s AI gave Philadelphia police a fake tip about an unsolved homicide
summary: Anthropic's AI model sent a false tip to Philadelphia police. The tip concerned an unsolved homicide. Police flagged the AI-generated information as fake, preventing review.

headline: Ohio blogger found guilty of harassment for sending Shrek nude to senator
summary: An Ohio blogger was found guilty of harassment. He sent an explicit Shrek image to a state senator. The blogger was fined $200 for the offense.

headline: ‘Pure insanity’: Mathematicians will need years to make sense of OpenAI’s latest drop
summary: OpenAI has released a massive trove of mathematical results. Mathematicians describe the findings as "staggering" and "overwhelming." Experts expect to spend years fully comprehending OpenAI's breakthrough.

headline: Konami Planning 'Second and Third Waves' of New Silent Hill Games
summary: Konami plans multiple new Silent Hill game waves. Producer Motoi Okamoto confirmed future titles. This suggests a significant revitalization for the franchise.

headline: Blumhouse Partners With MatPat to Make Amanda the Adventurer Movie, Confirms More Indie Horror Game Adaptations Are Coming | NYCC 2026
summary: Blumhouse and MatPat are collaborating on indie horror game movies. The first adaptation will be "Amanda the Adventurer." More indie horror game films are confirmed to be in development.

headline: Is The Exorcist: Martyrs a Sequel to The Exorcist III? Mike Flanagan Reveals All
summary: Director Mike Flanagan discusses "The Exorcist: Martyrs." He clarifies its connection to "The Exorcist III." The interview breaks down the new horror sequel's trailer.

headline: A Street Fighter Movie Sequel Is Already Being Written, but There’s a Catch
summary: A "Street Fighter" movie sequel is already being written. Director Kitao Sakurai is developing the script. The sequel's fate hinges on the first movie's box office performance.

headline: Trump announces deal for Russian diesel as Zelensky criticises 'gift to Putin'
summary: Trump announced a deal for Russian diesel. Ukraine's President Zelensky criticized the move. Zelensky called it a "gift to Putin" that prolongs the war.

headline: Analysis: Trump's shock Russia deal highlights mounting pressure to curb fuel prices
summary: Trump's Russia deal aims to curb rising fuel prices. The move is seen as an effort to benefit his party. It comes ahead of next month's midterm elections.

headline: NI secretary to ban the Drumcree parade
summary: The NI Secretary plans to ban the Drumcree parade. This follows a nearly two-week stand-off. The dispute involves Orangemen and nationalist residents.

headline: Screams, haunting scenes and deadly hide-and-seek, as Celebrity Traitors heats up
summary: "Celebrity Traitors" episode four featured intense drama. Another contestant was "killed off" in the game. The episode included a ghoulish mission and a spooky twist.
